headline: PAOK favoured at 56%, goals market repriced before kick-off
summary: The market has PAOK at 56.0% fair to win, the draw at 24.1% and OFI at 19.9%, with the handicap fair line at 0.77 goals in PAOK's favour. The goals market made one big single-step move at 04:26: Over 2.75 consensus rose from 40.3% to 48.1% and the fair total from 2.36 to 2.67, driven by two soft books, while BTTS Yes climbed to 54.2%.
video_title: PAOK favoured, but the goals move needs a third print
key_points: Over 2.75 jumped 7.8 pp (40.3% → 48.1%), fair total 2.36 → 2.67 — one 04:26 step from two books
BTTS Yes 49.6% → 54.2% and AH fair line 0.63 → 0.77: same direction, modest size
